title: Where to Find Affordable Riley Green Tour Tickets Online, Starting From $35
summary: The country star is currently on his "Cowboy As It Gets" tour, which takes him across the country with dates through the end of 2026.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Riley Green’s big year is only going to get bigger with the release of the country singer’s fourth studio album, That’s Just Me , in September, along with a starring role on season 30 of The Voice .

Green is also currently on his “Cowboy As It Gets” tour , which takes him across the country, including a two-night stint at Resorts World Las Vegas in December. Originally slated to conclude in August, fan demand for Green’s tour led to new dates added through the end of the year.

Ticketmaster is the official ticketing site for Green’s tour, though many of his dates are sold out on Ticketmaster.com . Still, you can find verified resale tickets online through the platform.

Where to Find Cheap Riley Green Tickets Online

Another way to find Riley Green tour tickets online: try a third-party marketplace or resale site, where we’ve spotted tickets from as low as $35. All of these sites are backed by buyers’ guarantees that validate your ticket purchase to ensure you have authentic stubs in hand for the big show.

BEST SELECTION

Find Riley Green Tickets on StubHub

Buy TICKETS HERE

StubHub has the widest selection of Riley Green tickets online as of this writing, and prices start at $74 per our searching.

StubHub offers all-in pricing with all fees listed upfront — no surprises when checking out your cart. The site’s FanProtect Guarantee, meantime, ensures that your tickets will be valid and delivered in time for the concert or your money back. And if the show is canceled and not rescheduled (a real possibility since Green is playing a number of outdoor venues), you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund.

EDITOR'S CHOICE

Find Riley Green Tickets on SeatGeek

I like buying my concert tickets on SeatGeek, thanks to the site’s easy-to-navigate search feature, which lets you search by price point and perks, while giving you a pretty accurate (read: realistic) view of where your seats will be — and how the stage will look from your section.

Tickets are delivered digitally via email so I have them on my phone before I go through security. And prices have been surprisingly reasonable in my experience. Case in point: SeatGeek has cheap Riley Green tickets online from just $50. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

LOWEST PRICES

Find Riley Green Tickets on Vivid Seats

Riley Green tickets at Vivid Seats start at $35 right now — the lowest price on this list.

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat (i.e. suite, standing room, front of section, VIP) and the site prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly-rated sellers.” Either way, your purchase is protected by the site’s 100% Buyer Guarantee, which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for your event or your money back.

ALSO CONSIDER

Find Riley Green Tickets at TicketNetwork

Ticketmaster may be the official ticketing site for Green’s “Cowboy As It Gets” tour, but don’t sleep on TicketNetwork , which is a great place to find ticket packages that include parking, VIP access, meet and greets, and more.

Because TicketNetwork is a resale site, they say that prices may sometimes be below face value , as they aren’t held to a specific selling price. They also guarantee that the tickets you receive will be the ones you ordered — or better.

Green’s new album arrives on the heels of a breakout 2025 for the Alabama native, who took consecutive solo-written songs to No. 1 on  Billboard’s  Country Airplay chart. He then teamed with Ella Langley on the Country Airplay No. 1 hit “ Don’t Mind If I Do. “

Now Green makes his move over to the mainstream audience, serving as a coach on The Voice this fall alongside Kelly Clarkson and Adam Levine. The country star has also just signed on to be a part of The Voice: Celebrity , premiering in 2027.
